missed.maker: Texas Instruments (data sheet SBVS249B, Nov 2020); S1 allowlist name Texas Instruments
missed.why: The only family found with a built-in latch, the requirement P2's rank 1 TLV6710 misses. https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps3703.pdf, read 2026-09-29T10:15:48Z. Section 9.1.3 'RESET Latch Mode': with CT to ground through a resistor, RESET stays low after a trip until CT is driven above VCT, 1.133 to 1.167 V; TI recommends above 1.2 V. That unlatch is a firmware or operator action, which meets V130. VIT+(OV) accuracy is +/-0.7 % over -40 to 125 C for thresholds of 800 mV and above, and +/-1 % below. With 0.1 % dividers that is +/-0.9 %, against the +/-0.99 % HV band. ISENSE is 1.5 uA max at 5 V; that error needs a divider source impedance under about 500 Ohm to stay in the band. SENSE absolute maximum is 6 V. A 0.85 V nominal option maps 20 V on the rail to about 3 V on SENSE in either jumper position. The 1.8 V option exceeds 6 V in the LV position, and the 3.3 V option exceeds it in both. It is a window part: the UV side also pulls RESET low and latches, including at power-up with the rail or port down, so firmware must hold CT high until the rail is in range. JLCPCB fails rule 4 (500) in every suitable variant. TPS3703A4085DSERQ1 C2931004: 72, read 10:25:51Z. TPS3703A7080DSERQ1 C3687441: 10, read 10:25:52Z. TPS3703A5180DSER C2862899: 80, read 10:25:51Z. TPS3703A4120DSERQ1 C2067330: 55, read 10:25:52Z. TPS3703A7330DSERQ1 C1849519 has 307, read 10:25:51Z, and fails the 20 V withstand without a clamp. Digi-Key: TPS3703A4085DSERQ1 0 in stock, Active, lead 26 weeks, read 10:27:46Z; TPS3703A7080DSERQ1 0 in stock, Active, lead 26 weeks, read 10:27:49Z. TI product page, read 10:26:50Z: A-variant orderables listed ACTIVE. The TLV6713 (read 10:15:48Z) and TPS3899 (read 10:15:48Z) were examined. The TLV6713's rising threshold is 400 to 413 mV and the TPS3899's accuracy is +/-2.5 % max; both fail the HV band.
